statement: Verdant Studio exists to generate applications and their multimedia, and its pipelines implement the production process that creates its content, a Verdant Prism: one media type, or a bundle of media types that makes up an application, including the WebAssembly that runs in a browser or a WebAssembly runtime. A Verdant Prism is created from a single word or sentence; Verdant Studio specifies a subset of the Prism from that seed, and the Prism's generators generate all its other facets, because every part of Verdant Studio has a generator for its multimedia, such as a song, a soundtrack, cover art or a logo. The user may tune as few or as many features as they choose until all of the Prism's features meet its intent. The generators always define the Prism to ultra-high precision through the coherence of all of Verdant Studio's models, so that every part is defined consistently to its full expression, and this is verified by prompting Verdant Studio and checking that every artifact has its correct media type and the highest fidelity.
